items.title: it 作形式主语
items.brief: it 占主语位，真主语后置为不定式或从句

concept.summary: 判定分三步：一看句首的 it 是否有所指，二看后面是否有不定式、动名词或 that 从句，三做还原测试——把后置成分搬到句首，若句子仍成立，it 就是形式主语。it 在这里不指任何具体事物，只负责占住主语位置，避免头重脚轻。

sections.p: 三步按顺序执行，任何一步不通过就不是形式主语。第一步排除指代用法，第二步确认后置成分存在，第三步用还原测试作最终结论。
bullets: 第一步：it 能否换成前文某个名词？能换的是人称代词 it，不能换的才是形式主语。
第二步：后面是否有 to do、doing 或 that/whether 从句？没有则不是形式主语。
第三步：还原测试。It is hard to please everyone. → To please everyone is hard. 成立，确认为形式主语。
还原后不成立说明是别的结构，不能按形式主语处理。

sections.p: 真正的主语可以是三种非谓语或从句形式，选哪种由前面的形容词或名词决定，这一点决定了填空时该写 to do 还是 doing。
bullets: 不定式：It is important to arrive early. / It takes two hours to get there.
动名词：It is no use crying over spilt milk. / It is worth trying again.
从句：It is clear that he lied. / It matters whether we act now.
被动 + 从句：It is said that the bridge will reopen in May.

sections.p: 需要标出“谁来做”时，用 for 或 of 引出逻辑主语。判断依据是形容词修饰事情还是修饰人：描述事情性质的用 for，描述人的品性的用 of。
bullets: It is important for you to rest.（important 描述事情）
It is kind of you to help.（kind 描述人的品性）
× It is important of you to rest. / × It is kind for you to help.
no use / no good 后只能接动名词：It is no good complaining.

examples.en: It is essential to back up your files before updating the system.
examples.zh: 更新系统前备份文件是必要的。
examples.note: it 占主语位，真主语是不定式 to back up your files。

examples.en: It is no use arguing with the referee.
examples.zh: 和裁判争论没有用。
examples.note: no use 后接动名词，arguing 是真正的主语。

examples.en: It is no use to argue with the referee.
examples.zh: 和裁判争论没有用。
examples.note: no use / no good 后固定接动名词，不能用不定式。

examples.en: It is clear that the two sides will not reach an agreement today.
examples.zh: 很明显双方今天不会达成协议。
examples.note: 真主语是 that 从句，it 只是占位。

examples.en: Is clear that the two sides will not reach an agreement today.
examples.zh: 很明显双方今天不会达成协议。
examples.note: 缺少形式主语 it，句子没有主语；从句后置时 it 不能省。

examples.en: It seems that the train has been delayed.
examples.zh: 火车似乎晚点了。
examples.note: seem 后用 that 从句，it 作形式主语。

examples.en: It took me three hours to finish the report.
examples.zh: 我花了三个小时完成这份报告。
examples.note: it 为形式主语，真主语是 to finish the report，me 是间接宾语。

pitfalls.wrong: Is necessary to check the data twice.
pitfalls.right: It is necessary to check the data twice.
pitfalls.why: 不定式后置后句首没有主语，英语陈述句必须有主语，须用 it 占位。

pitfalls.wrong: It is no good to smoke here.
pitfalls.right: It is no good smoking here.
pitfalls.why: no good / no use 后的真主语固定为动名词，不定式不成立。

pitfalls.wrong: It is important for you study every day.
pitfalls.right: It is important for you to study every day.
pitfalls.why: for 引出的是不定式的逻辑主语，后面必须接完整的 to do，不能直接跟动词原形。

contrast.diff: 形式主语在句首、真主语在谓语之后；形式宾语在动词之后、真宾语在宾补之后，位置和触发结构完全不同。

concept.mnemonic: it 站前排占位，真主语排队在后；能搬回句首的是形式主语。

core: 判定三步：it 是否有所指 → 后面有无后置成分 → 还原测试是否成立
真主语可以是不定式、动名词或 that/whether 从句
no use / no good / worth 后接动名词，不接不定式
描述事情性质用 for sb.，描述人的品性用 of sb.
it 不能省略，否则句子没有主语
review.trigger: 看到句首 it 后面跟着形容词 + to do/that 从句 → 立刻做还原测试 → 成立即形式主语

quickCheck.q: It is hard to please everyone. 的真主语是什么？
quickCheck.a: to please everyone，it 是形式主语。

quickCheck.q: It is no use ___ (cry) over spilt milk. 填什么？
It is kind ___ you to help. 填 for 还是 of？

drills.stem: ___ is essential that every applicant submit two references.
drills.answer: It
drills.explain: that 从句后置，句首需要形式主语 it 占位；essential 是对事情的评价，符合 it is + adj. + that 从句的结构。
drills.trap: That 会与后面的 that 从句重复，且句首仍然缺主语；There 只能构成 there be 存在句。

drills.stem: It is no use ___ (complain) about the decision now.
drills.answer: complaining
drills.hint: no use 后面接什么形式？
drills.explain: no use 后的真主语固定为动名词，须用 complaining；不定式 to complain 不成立。

drills.stem: Is important to read the instructions before you start.
drills.answer: It is important to read the instructions before you start.
accept: It is important to read the instructions before you start.
drills.explain: 不定式作主语后置后，句首缺主语，必须补形式主语 it，构成 It is important to do sth.。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It takes about two hours to get there by bus.
drills.explain: it 为形式主语，真主语 to get there by bus 后置；take 在此表“花费时间”，后接时间量。

drills.stem: 每天练习三十分钟是必要的。
drills.answer: It is necessary to practise for thirty minutes every day.
drills.explain: 不定式作真主语须后置，句首用 it 占位；necessary 描述事情，若引出逻辑主语应用 for sb. 而非直接跟动词。

drills.stem: It is careless ___ him to leave the door unlocked.
drills.answer: of
drills.explain: careless 描述的是人的品性，属于“某人具有某种特质”，须用 of + 人 + to do 的结构。
drills.trap: for 用于描述事情性质的形容词，如 important、necessary、difficult，与 careless 的语义指向不同。

items.title: it 作形式宾语
items.brief: 宾补紧跟 it，真宾语后置到补语之后

concept.summary: 判定标准：动词后先出现 it，接着是形容词或名词作宾语补足语，最后才是真正宾语（不定式、动名词或从句）。英语要求宾补紧跟宾语，长宾语必须后移，因此需要 it 占位；it 不能省略，也不能换成 this 或 that。

sections.p: 判定按三步走：先确认 it 无所指，再确认它后面紧跟补足语，最后确认补足语之后还有真宾语。三步都成立才是形式宾语，缺一步就是别的结构。
bullets: 第一步：找到动词后的 it，看它是否指代前文名词；不指代才继续。
第二步：看 it 后是否紧跟形容词或名词作补足语（hard, clear, necessary, a privilege）。
第三步：看补足语之后是否有 to do、doing 或 that 从句，这段才是真宾语。
公式：主语 + 动词 + it + 宾补 + 真宾语，如 I find it hard to concentrate.
反证：把真宾语搬到 it 的位置（× I find to concentrate hard.）不成立，说明 it 不可省。

sections.p: 这类动词都是“认为、使得、发现”类，允许宾语后接补足语。动词本身决定结构是否成立，不能凭汉语“我觉得……”直接类推。
bullets: make, find, think, consider, feel, believe, regard, take, count, deem
take it for granted that...（想当然认为）
appreciate it if...（若……将不胜感激）
see to it that... / depend on it that...（介词后也可用 it 占位）
× suggest it necessary to do；× explain it that...

sections.p: 同一个动词可以带不同结构，判断依据是宾语的长度与是否带补足语。宾语是短名词时不需要 it；宾语是不定式或从句时才需要后移。
bullets: 形式宾语：I find it hard to concentrate in noise.
复合宾语（短名词作宾语）：I find the task hard.
形式主语：It is hard to concentrate in noise.
宾语从句（无补足语）：I think that he is right.

examples.en: I find it difficult to keep up with the reading list.
examples.zh: 我发现很难跟上书单的进度。
examples.note: it 占宾语位，difficult 作宾补，真宾语 to keep up... 后置。

examples.en: I find difficult to keep up with the reading list.
examples.zh: 我发现很难跟上书单的进度。
examples.note: 缺形式宾语 it，difficult 直接跟宾语不成立，宾补必须有宾语支撑。

examples.en: She made it clear that she would not accept the offer.
examples.zh: 她明确表示不会接受这个提议。
examples.note: that 从句后置，it 占位，clear 作宾补。

examples.en: They consider it a privilege to work with him.
examples.zh: 他们认为与他共事是一种荣幸。
examples.note: 名词 a privilege 作宾补，真宾语是不定式。

examples.en: He explained it that the delay was unavoidable.
examples.zh: 他解释说延误是不可避免的。
examples.note: explain 不接 it 作形式宾语，应直接说 He explained that the delay was unavoidable.

examples.en: We take it for granted that clean water is available.
examples.zh: 我们想当然地认为干净的水随时都有。
examples.note: take it for granted that 是固定结构，it 不可省。

examples.en: I would appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.
examples.zh: 如果你能在周五前回复，我将不胜感激。
examples.note: appreciate it if 是固定搭配，it 指代后面 if 从句的内容。

pitfalls.wrong: I consider impossible to finish the work by Friday.
pitfalls.right: I consider it impossible to finish the work by Friday.
pitfalls.why: 不定式作宾语太长须后移，impossible 作宾补需要宾语支撑，缺 it 则结构断裂。

pitfalls.wrong: She made clear that she disagreed.
pitfalls.right: She made it clear that she disagreed.
pitfalls.why: make 的宾语从句后移后，宾补 clear 前必须有 it 占位，否则 clear 直接跟在 made 后无宾语。

pitfalls.wrong: We take that he is honest for granted.
pitfalls.right: We take it for granted that he is honest.
pitfalls.why: take...for granted 是固定结构，it 固定在 take 与 for granted 之间，从句置于句末。

contrast.diff: 形式主语在句首、真主语在谓语之后；形式宾语在动词之后、真宾语在宾补之后，两者的位置与触发结构都不同。

concept.mnemonic: 宾补不能悬空，it 先垫个位；长宾语往后排。

core: 公式：动词 + it + 宾补（形容词/名词）+ 真宾语
常用动词：make, find, think, consider, feel, believe, regard, take
固定搭配：take it for granted that / appreciate it if / see to it that
it 不能省略，because 宾补必须紧跟宾语
宾语是短名词时不用 it：I find the task hard.
review.trigger: 看到 find/think/make + 形容词/名词 + to do 或 that 从句 → 中间必须有 it

quickCheck.q: I find it hard to concentrate. 中 it 是什么成分？
quickCheck.a: 形式宾语，真宾语是 to concentrate。

quickCheck.q: We take ___ for granted that he is honest. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: it，take it for granted 是固定结构。

quickCheck.q: I find the task hard. 需要加 it 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不需要，宾语 the task 是短名词，直接跟宾补。

drills.stem: She found ___ hard to admit that she had been wrong.
drills.answer: it
drills.explain: hard 是宾补，真正宾语是 to admit that she had been wrong，须用 it 占住宾语位置。
drills.trap: that 会引导从句，但 hard 后面无法直接接从句，宾补前的空位只能由 it 填充。

drills.stem: The new rules make ___ compulsory for all staff to wear badges.
drills.answer: it
drills.hint: compulsory 是宾补，真宾语是后面的不定式。
drills.explain: make 后接宾补 compulsory，真宾语 to wear badges 后置，中间必须用形式宾语 it 占位。

drills.stem: I think important to check the figures before publication.
drills.answer: I think it important to check the figures before publication.
accept: I think it important to check the figures before publication.
drills.explain: think 后接宾补 important，真宾语是不定式，须先用 it 占位，否则宾补没有依附对象。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: They consider it a privilege to work with her.
drills.explain: 名词 a privilege 作宾补，真宾语 to work with her 后置，it 占宾语位置不可省。

drills.stem: 我们认为有必要重新考虑这个决定。
drills.answer: We consider it necessary to reconsider the decision.
drills.explain: consider 后接宾补 necessary，真宾语 to reconsider the decision 后置，须用 it 占位；consider 后不接 that 从句与宾补混用。

drills.stem: I would appreciate ___ if you could send the file today.
drills.answer: it
drills.explain: appreciate it if 是固定结构，it 指代后面 if 从句表达的情况，不能换成 that 或 this。
drills.trap: that 会让人误以为要接宾语从句，但 appreciate 后接 if 从句时必须先用 it 占位。

items.title: it 在强调句中的用法
items.brief: 去掉 It is/was...that 仍成句才是强调句

concept.summary: 强调句的结构是 It is/was + 被强调成分 + that/who + 其余部分，可强调主语、宾语和各类状语，但不能强调谓语动词。判定的唯一硬标准是还原测试：删去 It is/was 与 that/who，把被强调成分放回原位，若剩余部分能组成语法完整的句子，才是强调句。

sections.p: 被强调成分夹在 It is/was 与 that 之间，位置固定。它原本在句中作什么成分，还原后就要放回什么位置。指人时连接词可用 who 或 that，其余一律用 that。
bullets: 强调主语：It was the manager who approved the budget.
强调宾语：It was the budget that the manager approved.
强调时间状语：It was in 1998 that she moved to Beijing.
强调地点状语：It was in the library that I first met her.
谓语动词不能这样强调，改用 do/does/did：He did call me.

sections.p: 这套动作要按顺序做完，不能只看一眼就下结论。前两步是拆，第三步是归位，第四步是验句；四步中任何一步失败，就不是强调句。
bullets: 动作一：划掉句首的 It is 或 It was。
动作二：划掉连接词 that 或 who。
动作三：把中间那段被强调成分搬回原句被抽走的位置。
动作四：读一遍剩下部分。若是一个语法完整的句子（有主语、谓语，时态自洽），即为强调句；若只剩下“形容词/名词 + that 从句”这类残片，则为形式主语。
示例：It was in 1998 that she moved to Beijing. → 去掉 It was 与 that → in 1998 归位 → She moved to Beijing in 1998. 完整，确认强调句。
反例：It is clear that she moved to Beijing. → 去掉 It is 与 that → clear 归位 → Clear she moved to Beijing. 不成句，故为形式主语而非强调句。

sections.h: 辅助检查：that 是否充当成分
sections.p: 当还原测试仍有疑问时，用第二个标准交叉验证：看 that 后面是不是一个完整分句。强调句的 that 只起连接作用，不作成分，因此它后面必须自成完整分句；定语从句的 that 充当主语或宾语，删掉后从句就会缺成分。
bullets: 强调句：It was in 1998 that she moved to Beijing. → that 后 she moved to Beijing 是完整分句。
定语从句：It is a habit that is hard to break. → that 后 is hard to break 缺主语，that 是从句主语。
主谓一致：It is I who am responsible.（正式）／It is me who is responsible.（口语）
not until 的强调：It was not until midnight that he came back.（that 后不倒装）

examples.en: It was in 1998 that she moved to Beijing.
examples.zh: 她是在 1998 年搬到北京的。
examples.note: 强调时间状语，还原为 She moved to Beijing in 1998. 完整。

examples.en: It was the manager who approved the budget.
examples.zh: 批准预算的是经理。
examples.note: 强调主语，指人可用 who，还原为 The manager approved the budget.

examples.en: It was in 1998 when she moved to Beijing.
examples.zh: 她是在 1998 年搬到北京的。
examples.note: 强调时间状语连接词固定用 that，用 when 会使结构变成含定语从句的句子。

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he came back.
examples.zh: 直到午夜他才回来。
examples.note: not until 的强调结构，that 后用陈述语序，不倒装。

examples.en: It was in the library where I first met her.
examples.zh: 我第一次遇见她是在图书馆。
examples.note: 强调地点状语用 that，where 只能引导定语从句修饰表地点的名词。

examples.en: It is I who is responsible for the delay.
examples.zh: 造成延误的人是我。
examples.note: 强调主语时 who 后的谓语与被强调成分一致，I 对应 am，应改为 who am。

examples.en: It was not his words but his silence that hurt her.
examples.zh: 伤害她的不是他的话，而是他的沉默。
examples.note: 被强调成分是并列名词短语，连接词仍用 that。

examples.en: It is I who am to blame for the mistake.
examples.zh: 这个错误该由我负责。
examples.note: 正式文体中 who 后的谓语与被强调的 I 保持一致，用 am。

pitfalls.wrong: It was in 2010 when he joined the company.
pitfalls.right: It was in 2010 that he joined the company.
pitfalls.why: 强调句的连接词固定为 that（指人可用 who），when 会把句子变成含定语从句的结构。

pitfalls.wrong: It is Tom who have finished the report.
pitfalls.right: It is Tom who has finished the report.
pitfalls.why: 强调主语时，who 后的谓语与被强调的名词 Tom 保持一致，用单数 has。

pitfalls.wrong: It was the window that Tom broke it.
pitfalls.right: It was the window that Tom broke.
pitfalls.why: 被强调成分已经回到宾语位置，that 后不能再保留一个代词 it，否则宾语重复。

contrast.diff: 形式主语去掉 it 后句子不成立，真主语是后面的不定式或从句；强调句去掉 It is...that 后剩余部分能还原成一个完整句子。

concept.mnemonic: 拆掉 It is 和 that，成分归位还成句——是强调；还不了原的是形式主语。

core: 结构：It is/was + 被强调成分 + that/who + 其余部分
还原测试：删 It is/was 与 that/who，成分归位，仍成句才是强调句
辅助检查：that 后必须是完整分句，that 不作成分
指人可用 who，其余一律 that；not until 强调后用陈述语序
谓语动词不能强调，改用 do/does/did
review.trigger: 看到 It is/was ... that ... → 先做还原测试 → 归位后成句才按强调句处理

quickCheck.q: It is clear that he lied. 是强调句吗？
quickCheck.a: 不是，去掉 It is 与 that 后 clear he lied 不成句，属于形式主语。

quickCheck.q: It was in 1998 ___ she moved to Beijing. 填什么？
强调谓语动词用什么手段？
quickCheck.a: 用助动词 do/does/did，如 He did call me.

drills.stem: It was not until she read the letter ___ she realized the truth.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: not until 的强调结构固定为 It was not until...that...，that 只起连接作用；还原后 She did not realize the truth until she read the letter. 完整。
drills.trap: when 会让人按时间状语从句理解，但前面已有 It was 框架，连接词只能是 that。

drills.stem: It ___ his encouragement that helped me through the hardest year.
drills.answer: was
drills.hint: 看后面 helped 的时态。
drills.explain: 从句谓语 helped 是过去时，强调句的 be 须与之呼应，用 was；被强调成分 his encouragement 是单数，也用 was。

drills.stem: It was in the library where I first met her.
drills.answer: It was in the library that I first met her.
accept: It was in the library that I first met her.
drills.explain: 被强调的是地点状语 in the library，强调句的连接词用 that；where 只能引导定语从句修饰地点名词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It was his attitude that impressed the interviewers.
drills.explain: 被强调的是主语 his attitude，还原为 His attitude impressed the interviewers. 结构完整，确认为强调句。

drills.stem: 正是这位老师改变了我对数学的看法。
drills.answer: It was this teacher who changed my view of mathematics.
forbid: it is this teacher who changed
drills.explain: 强调主语且指人，用 It was...who...；连接词不能省略，也不能用现在时 is 与过去动作搭配。

drills.stem: He ___ call you yesterday, but you did not answer.
drills.answer: did
drills.explain: 强调谓语动词只能用助动词 do/does/did 加动词原形，过去时用 did，不能用 It is/was...that 结构。
drills.trap: was 会让人误用强调句框架，但句中没有 that 从句，且强调对象是谓语动词 call。

items.title: it 表时间、天气、距离的无人称用法
items.brief: 无所指的 it 作唯一主语，汉语常不译出

concept.summary: 判定标准：it 既不指代前文名词，也不是形式主语（后面没有可还原的不定式或从句），而是句子的唯一主语，用于时间、日期、天气、温度、距离与环境。这类 it 在汉语里通常不译出，但英语句子里不能省略，也不能换成 there be。

sections.p: 这六类覆盖了绝大多数出现场景，判断时只需看 it 后面的中心词属于哪一类，不需要分析句子成分。
bullets: 时间与日期：It is ten past six. / It is Monday. / It is already midnight.
天气与气候：It is raining. / It is getting colder. / It was windy yesterday.
温度：It is twenty degrees outside.
距离：It is three miles to the station. / It is a long way from here.
环境与情况：It is noisy in here. / It is getting dark.
笼统指代：How is it going? / It is my turn.

sections.p: 无人称 it 是句法上的强制主语，删掉句子就不合法。天气动词尤其严格，主语只能是 it，不能换成 today 或 there。
bullets: 不能省：× Is very cold today. → It is very cold today.
不能换 there：× There is raining. → It is raining.
天气动词 rain/snow/drizzle/thunder/pour 只能以 it 作主语：× Today is raining.
距离常用 it is + 距离 + to/from：It is two miles from here to the beach.

sections.p: 两者句首都是 it，用同一套动作区分：一看 it 后面紧跟什么，二找有没有能搬回句首的成分，三看搬回后是否成句。搬不回去、也找不到后置成分的，就是无人称 it。
bullets: 第一步：看 it 后面紧跟的是形容词、名词还是时间，而不是 to do 或从句。
第二步：找句中有没有可以搬到句首作主语的不定式、动名词或 that 从句。
第三步：有且搬回后成立 → 形式主语；没有可搬成分 → 无人称 it。
无人称：It is cold.（无后置成分，搬不回去）
形式主语：It is cold to stand outside in such weather.（真主语是 to stand outside）
无人称：It is a long way to the airport.
形式主语：It is important to book a taxi in advance.

examples.en: It is freezing outside, so put on a thicker coat.
examples.zh: 外面冷极了，穿件厚一点的外套。
examples.note: it 表天气，无具体所指，是句子的唯一主语。

examples.en: There is freezing outside, so put on a thicker coat.
examples.zh: 外面冷极了，穿件厚一点的外套。
examples.note: there be 表存在，不能带表天气的形容词；天气须用无人称 it 作主语。

examples.en: It is about twenty minutes' walk from the station to the hotel.
examples.zh: 从车站到酒店大约步行二十分钟。
examples.note: it 表距离，后接距离短语与 from...to 结构。

examples.en: Is about twenty minutes' walk from the station to the hotel.
examples.zh: 从车站到酒店大约步行二十分钟。
examples.note: 英语陈述句必须有主语，距离表达同样需要 it 占位。

examples.en: It rained heavily all night, and the roads were flooded.
examples.zh: 整夜下大雨，道路被淹了。
examples.note: rain 是天气动词，主语固定为 it。

examples.en: It is already midnight, and the children are still awake.
examples.zh: 已经午夜了，孩子们还醒着。
examples.note: it 表时间，汉语不译出，但英语不能省。

examples.en: Today is raining heavily, so we stayed indoors.
examples.zh: 今天下大雨，所以我们待在室内。
examples.note: 天气动词的主语只能是无人称 it，today 是时间状语，不能作 rain 的主语。

pitfalls.why: rain 是天气动词，主语固定为无人称 it；there be 只表存在，不能带天气谓语。

pitfalls.wrong: Is very hot in July here.
pitfalls.right: It is very hot in July here.
pitfalls.why: 英语陈述句必须有主语，表天气的形容词前要用 it 占位。

pitfalls.wrong: It is three miles walk to the beach.
pitfalls.right: It is a three-mile walk to the beach.
pitfalls.why: 距离作前置定语时用复合定语 three-mile，名词用单数并加连字符；不能直接用 three miles walk。

contrast.diff: 无人称 it 后面没有可还原的后置真主语；形式主语后面一定有不定式、动名词或从句能搬回句首。

concept.mnemonic: 时间天气和距离，it 必到场；汉语不说它，英语不能少。

core: it 表时间、日期、天气、温度、距离、环境，无具体所指
it 不能省略，也不能换成 there be 或 today
天气动词 rain/snow/thunder 的主语固定为 it
距离用 it is + 距离 + to/from 结构
后面没有 to do 或从句时是无人称 it，不是形式主语
review.trigger: 看到汉语“下雨了/很冷/六点了/很远” → 英语一律先写 It is

quickCheck.q: There is raining. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 天气动词的主语是无人称 it，应用 It is raining.

quickCheck.q: It is cold. 与 It is cold to stand outside. 有何不同？
quickCheck.a: 前者是无人称 it 表天气，后者是形式主语，真主语是 to stand outside。

drills.stem: ___ has been raining since early morning, so the pitch is soaked.
drills.answer: It
drills.explain: rain 是天气动词，主语只能是无人称 it；现在完成进行时由 has been raining 承担。
drills.trap: There 会构成 there be 存在句，而存在句不能带 rain 的进行时谓语。

drills.stem: ___ is only a ten-minute walk from my flat to the office.
drills.answer: It
drills.hint: 句首需要一个表距离的主语。
drills.explain: 表距离的句子需要无人称 it 作主语，后接距离短语与 from...to 结构；ten-minute 为复合定语，用单数。

drills.stem: There is snowing heavily in the mountains.
drills.answer: It is snowing heavily in the mountains.
accept: It is snowing heavily in the mountains.
drills.explain: snow 是天气动词，主语固定为无人称 it；there be 表存在，不能与天气动词的进行时搭配。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It is getting dark, so let's head back.
drills.explain: it 表环境变化（天黑），是无人称用法；后一分句用 so 连接表结果。

drills.stem: 从这儿到机场大约三十公里。
drills.answer: It is about thirty kilometres from here to the airport.
drills.explain: 距离表达用无人称 it 作主语，后接距离量与 from...to 结构，不能用 there be 或 have。

drills.stem: How far ___ from the campus to the nearest metro station?
drills.answer: is it
drills.explain: 特殊疑问句中无人称 it 作主语，与 be 倒装为 is it；how far 问距离。
drills.trap: is there 会构成存在句，问的是“有没有”，与 how far 问距离不相容。

items.title: it 的固定句型
items.brief: 六组高频 it 句型，见标志直接套结构

concept.summary: 固定句型的判定线索是 it 后面已经绑定了特定动词或名词，例如 it is said/reported that、it seems that、it is the first time that、it is high time that、it is no use doing、it is up to sb. to do。看到这些标志不必再做还原测试，直接按句型要求填形式与时态即可。

sections.p: 这类句型有两个等价形式：it + be + 过去分词 + that 从句，或主语 + be + 过去分词 + 不定式。转换时先分清动作先后：先发生的动作改用不定式完成式。
bullets: It is said that he owns three houses. = He is said to own three houses.
It is reported/believed/thought/estimated that...
It seems/appears that he knows the answer. = He seems to know the answer.
It is said that he left. → He is said to have left.（动作先于谓语）

sections.p: 这一类靠主句时态决定从句时态，是语法填空的高频点。记法是：主句现在时，从句用现在完成；主句过去时，从句用过去完成。
bullets: It is the first time that + 现在完成：It is the first time that I have seen the sea.
It was the third time that + 过去完成：It was the third time that she had failed.
It is (high) time that + 一般过去（或 should do）：It is high time we left.
It is/has been + 时间段 + since + 一般过去：It is three years since we met.

sections.p: 这些结构已经词汇化，形式固定，不能按语义自由替换动词形式。写作中直接整块使用即可。
bullets: It is no use / no good / useless doing sth.
It is worth doing sth. / It is no wonder that...
It is up to sb. to do sth.（由某人决定）
习惯表达：make it（成功/赶到）、take it easy、as I see it

examples.en: It is said that the old bridge will be rebuilt next year.
examples.zh: 据说这座老桥明年会重建。
examples.note: It is said that 是传闻类固定句型，从句用完整主谓。

examples.en: He is said to have left the country last month.
examples.zh: 据说他上个月已经离开这个国家了。
examples.note: 从句改为不定式时，先发生的动作须用完成式 to have left。

examples.en: It is said that he to own three houses.
examples.zh: 据说他拥有三套房子。
examples.note: that 从句必须有完整谓语，应说 that he owns three houses，或改用 He is said to own...

examples.en: It is the first time that I have flown in a helicopter.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次坐直升机。
examples.note: the first time 后的从句用现在完成时，与主句 is 呼应。

examples.en: It is the first time that I flew in a helicopter.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次坐直升机。
examples.note: 主句为现在时，the first time 后的从句须用现在完成时 have flown。

examples.en: It is high time we started to take the problem seriously.
examples.zh: 我们早该认真对待这个问题了。
examples.note: It is high time that 从句用一般过去时表虚拟，也可用 should + 动词原形。

examples.en: It is no wonder that sales have dropped since the price rise.
examples.zh: 难怪涨价后销量下降了。
examples.note: It is no wonder that 后接完整从句，表“难怪”。

examples.en: It is high time we start to take the problem seriously.
examples.zh: 我们早该认真对待这个问题了。
examples.note: It is high time that 从句须用一般过去时或 should + 动词原形，不能用一般现在时。

pitfalls.wrong: It is three years since we have met.
pitfalls.right: It is three years since we met.
pitfalls.why: since 从句的参照点是过去的那次见面，用一般过去时；主句 is 已经承担了“到现在为止三年”的意义。

pitfalls.wrong: It was the second time that he has visited Japan.
pitfalls.right: It was the second time that he had visited Japan.
pitfalls.why: 主句是过去时，the...time 从句须用过去完成时，表示动作先于主句。

pitfalls.wrong: It is no good to argue with the referee.
pitfalls.right: It is no good arguing with the referee.
pitfalls.why: no good / no use 后固定接动名词，不接不定式。

contrast.withTitle: there be 与 have 的区别及非谓语形式
contrast.diff: it 固定句型用形式主语承载评价、传闻或时间关系；there be 句型主语后置，只表存在，两者不能互换。

concept.mnemonic: first time 用完成，high time 用过去；said 后面接从句，改不定式要补 have。

core: It is said/reported/believed that... 可换成 sb./sth. is said to do
动作先于谓语时不定式用完成式：is said to have left
It is the first time that + 现在完成；It was the third time that + 过去完成
It is high time that + 一般过去或 should do
It is/has been + 时间段 + since + 一般过去
review.trigger: 看到 the first time / high time / since / it is said → 直接按对应时态模板填，不再分析成分

quickCheck.q: It is the first time that I ___ (see) the sea. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: have seen，主句现在时配现在完成。

quickCheck.q: It is high time we ___ (leave). 填什么？
It is three years since we ___ (meet). 填什么？
quickCheck.a: met，since 从句用一般过去时。

drills.stem: It is the first time that she ___ a speech in front of such a large audience.
drills.answer: has given
drills.explain: 主句 It is 为现在时，the first time 后的从句须用现在完成时，表示从过去到现在的经历。
drills.trap: gave 受汉语“第一次演讲”的过去意味影响，但与主句现在时冲突。

drills.stem: It is high time that we ___ (take) the safety regulations seriously.
drills.answer: took
drills.hint: high time 后的从句要用虚拟语气。
drills.explain: It is high time that 从句用一般过去时表虚拟，也可用 should + 动词原形，故填 took 或 should take。

drills.stem: It is three years since we have met each other.
drills.answer: It is three years since we met each other.
accept: It is three years since we met each other.
drills.explain: since 从句的起点是过去那次见面，用一般过去时；主句 is 已表示“到现在三年”。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It is said that the company is moving abroad.
drills.explain: It is said that 后接完整从句，从句用现在进行时表即将发生的安排。

drills.stem: 据说这座桥已经使用了一百多年。
drills.answer: It is said that the bridge has been in use for over a hundred years.
drills.explain: 传闻类句型用 It is said that 加完整从句；从句用现在完成时表持续到现在，被动含义由 be in use 承担。

drills.stem: It is no use ___ him for advice; he never answers his phone.
drills.answer: asking
drills.explain: no use 后的真主语固定为动名词，asking 表示“向他请教”这件事，后置由 it 占位。
drills.trap: to ask 是学习者最常写的形式，但 no use / no good 只接动名词。
